ch0162_90_koki/0101_0701_01_10:
I’ve been waiting,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]! I see you’re in
top form today, as always!
ch0162_90_koki/0101_0701_02_10: Let’s shine with all we’ve got!
ch0162_90_koki/7101_0701_01_10:
As a Pokémon Professor’s assistant, I’ve
supported others a lot.
ch0162_90_koki/7101_0701_02_10:
Now, I set an example for everyone.
As a Neo Champion of Pasio, I gotta keep
pushing!
ch0162_90_koki/7102_0701_01_10: The other day, Rei showed me his Pokédex.
ch0162_90_koki/7102_0701_02_10:
It had Pokémon entries from the Hisuian era!
They were so interesting!
ch0162_90_koki/7102_0701_03_10:
Considering Dialga rules over time and is my
partner Pokémon, maybe I should study
history more thoroughly.
ch0162_90_koki/7103_0701_01_10:
The number of Pokémon battles I’ve been
challenged to has increased since becoming
a Neo Champion.
ch0162_90_koki/7103_0701_02_10: Of course, I’m always ready for a challenge!
ch0162_90_koki/7103_0701_03_10:
I’ll continue to be everyone’s goal! Because
that’s my duty as a Neo Champion!
ch0162_90_koki/7104_0701_01_10:
Even as a Neo Champion, I keep tabs on
Dawn.
ch0162_90_koki/7104_0701_02_10:
At first, I was more experienced than Dawn,
but she kept advancing.
ch0162_90_koki/7104_0701_03_10: Even so, I’ll go head to head against her!
ch0162_90_koki/7105_0701_01_10: I heard a lot about Dialga from Adaman.
ch0162_90_koki/7105_0701_02_10: But there’s still so much I don’t know!
ch0162_90_koki/7105_0701_03_10:
[Name:PlayerNickname ], I hope you’ll
tell me what you learn about Dialga too!
ch0162_90_koki/1701_0702_01_10: If I find anything good later, it’s all yours!
ch0162_90_koki/2501_0701_01_10:
Now that I’m a Neo Champion, I’m catching
up to you two—the ideal sync pair!
ch0162_90_koki/2501_0701_02_10:
From here on, I’ll push even harder and
surpass you two!
ch0162_90_koki/2501_0702_01_10:
You always shine bright in the very heart
of Pasio!
ch0162_90_koki/2501_0702_02_10:
As a Neo Champion, I want to become a
sparkle in the heart of Pasio, too!
ch0162_90_koki/2511_0701_01_10:
The form Dialga changed into kinda looks like
Arceus, don’t you think?
ch0162_90_koki/2511_0701_02_10:
Its appearance may not be the only
similarity. Maybe its strength is closer to the
creator Pokémon’s now, too.
ch0162_90_koki/2511_0701_03_10:
I can’t be a Trainer who only LOOKS tough!
I have to be strong on the inside too!
ch0162_90_koki/2511_0702_01_10:
Someday, I want to take on Arceus with
Dialga at my side!
ch0162_90_koki/2511_0702_02_10:
When I do, [Name:PlayerNickname ],
I’ll be counting on your support!
ch0162_90_koki/3001_0701_01_10:
Basking in the morning sun gets me fired up!
I feel like I can take on anything—both fun
and challenging!
ch0162_90_koki/3003_0701_01_10:
You gotta keep taking on new challenges,
no matter what titles you earn. Once you
stop, that’s as far as you’ll go!
ch0162_90_koki/3005_0701_01_10:
I sure learned a lot today! If you have
comrades working toward the same goal,
you discover new things every day!
